description: Write values into several ranges in one call.

data.description: The list of range/value entries to write in one call; each entry pairs an A1-notation range with a 2D array of values.

range.description: The A1-notation range to write this entry to.

values.description: The 2D array of cell values to write for this entry, one inner array per row.

spreadsheet_id.description: The unique identifier of the spreadsheet to write to.

name: batch_update_values
